verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a `logseq://` protocol so third-party apps can invoke actions, including an x-callback-url quickCapture that can be bookmarked or opened from the command line. It also ships an opt-in local HTTP API server with bearer-token auth and a POST /api endpoint that dispatches plugin-API methods, with a curl example that creates a page block via logseq.Editor.insertBlock. missing for 10: explicit documentation of opening or navigating to a specific existing note via deep link, independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the app from outside — create or open notes via a URI scheme, deep links, or a local endpoint — to wire it into my scripts and workflows

citations.quote: Logseq provides a protocol `logseq://` to allow third party applications to invoke actions within Logseq.
Quick capture for short text and links. Can be added as a bookmark link to modern browser or opened from command line shell
we developed the local HTTP server to support external access to the database through authorization.
-d '{"method": "logseq.Editor.insertBlock", "args": ["Test page", "This is a new block", {"isPageBlock": true}]}'
